collection.title: Audi RS6 Avant 2013 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi RS6 Avant 2013 - 2018 which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this RS6 Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
